title: Graphic Designer
description:
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in Graphic Design,with hands-on experience in Digital Marketing and creating digital creatives for online platforms

Must have experience working with D2C brands in Personal Care,Skin Care,Hair Care,Beauty / FMCG products

Candidate applying for this position should be open to relocate to Ludhiana

Experience: 3-6 yrs

Key Skills: graphic designer,Graphics,Motion Graphics,Illustrator,Photoshop,Adobe,Graphic Designing,Indesign
